newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan mid-size insurers' latent stock profits fall.
newsitem.headline: Japan mid-size insurers' latent stock profits fall.

text.p: Unrealised profits on stock holdings at Japan's medium-sized life insurance companies fell during the year ended on March 31, 1997, according to data released by the companies on Tuesday.

The full names of the life insurers are Taiyo Mutual Life Insurance Co, Kyoei Life Insurance Co Ltd, Daido Life Insurance Co, Daihyaku Mutual Life Insurance Co, Toho Mutual Life Insurance Co, Nippon Dantai Life Insurance Co Ltd, Fukoku Mutual Life Insurance Co, and Tokyo Mutual Life Insurance Co. All of the life insurers are unlisted.
